CONFIRMED = stated scope only | CONFLICTING = evidence disagrees | PROPOSED = intent | UNKNOWN = insufficient evidence
B1 / RC PROPULSION DOMAIN — CURRENT 3S SCOPE; NO NEW MOTION-CONTROL INTERFACE
B2 / AUXILIARY DOMAIN — SOURCE-LISTED CONVERTERS; OUTPUT ASSIGNMENTS NOT VERIFIED
NEXT PHYSICAL CHECKS / RETAIN UNKNOWN VALUES UNTIL MEASURED OR TRACED
Installed models and BEC routing open.
Receiver / manual RC path to be traced.
No receiver-channel / servo pin map set.
Motor power vs servo/BEC feeds open.
No Pi / Uno actuation link in draft.
Fitted state and physical order open.
This box specifies no series order
NO COMMON 0V LINK IS ASSERTED BETWEEN B1 AND B2. Separate source boxes do not establish galvanic isolation.
All power arrows mean intended source-to-load allocation (+ and return unresolved), not a wiring or energization instruction.
PWR-O01 Read pack / dock / converter labels; trace both conductors and protection order.
PWR-O02 Confirm Pi power entry and Uno USB/external-power coexistence before choosing a route.
PWR-O03 Establish each light / sensor supply and converter load.
PWR-O04 Resolve returns / grounding; verify ratings under load.
